The MOTOX Guidebook: Beauty, Brains, & Botox What Patients Are Saying Frequently Asked Questions What is regenerative aesthetics? Regenerative aesthetics focuses on treatments that support collagen production, skin quality, and natural rejuvenation using advanced medical techniques. What are the best treatments for skin tightening? RF microneedling, biostimulators, laser treatments, and collagen stimulating procedures are commonly used to improve skin firmness and texture.
